subject: Supplier onboarding: records retention, DPA execution & subprocessor inventory request
messages:
From: Sophie Lam <sophie.lam@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Quick vendor kickoff questions + intake form

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier — excited to get ClearWave set up to receive POs from Redwood. Attached is our completed intake form and a first-pass subprocessor list. A couple of questions to help us move faster on our side: 

- Do you require an executed DPA before Redwood issues a PO, or can we proceed with PO issuance subject to DPA signature within X days?
- What is Redwood's standard records/data retention expectation for vendor-supplied logs and backups?
- Any preferred format for the subprocessor inventory (spreadsheet OK)?

We have also included our SOC report reference and can provide additional security evidence on request.

Attaching: ClearWave_Intake_Form.pdf, Subprocessors_List_v2.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Sophie Lam
Vendor Ops Lead
ClearWave Health
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Lam <sophie.lam@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Quick vendor kickoff questions + intake form

Hi Sophie — thanks for the intake and the subprocessors file. Looping in Marissa (Legal ops lead) and Karthik (Procurement) for visibility.

Short answers and next steps:

- DPA: Redwood prefers an executed DPA prior to invoice/PO activation for vendors handling customer or production data. To accelerate, please review the attached Redwood_DPA_Template.pdf; if you can sign our template or provide your marked-up version we can route to Legal for review. In some cases we may provisionally issue a PO to start non-production work while the DPA is in review, but that requires approval from Legal — we'll keep you posted.

- Retention: Standard requirement is that vendors retain customer-identifiable data only for as long as necessary for the service; operational logs (non-identifiable) default to 90 days unless an account-specific agreement requires longer. For backups and raw production snapshots, Redwood's default allowable retention is 13 months (395 days) unless otherwise negotiated — please indicate any constraints.

- Subprocessors: Spreadsheet is perfect. Please include column for data types each subprocessor touches, hosting region, and encryption-at-rest details.

What we need from you to get to PO: filled intake (we have that), redlined DPA or acceptance, W-9 (for US vendors), and billing contact. If you can get those over this week we can aim for PO issuance early next week.

Attached: Redwood_DPA_Template.pdf (stub)

Suggest a 30-min call tomorrow to align on open items. Are you available 10:30–11:00 PT?

Thanks,

--
Mina Haddad
Vendor Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
From: Sophie Lam <sophie.lam@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Quick vendor kickoff questions + intake form

Mina — appreciate the clear checklist. Quick responses below and attaching the requested spreadsheet with added columns.

- DPA: We can execute a DPA. We prefer to use our standard DPA but are happy to review Redwood's template. I've attached Subprocessors_List_v2.xlsx with the hosting region and a short note on data types.
- Retention: Operational logs: 90 days (we can extend on request). Backups/snapshots: 7 years for audit customers (we can scope per-account).
- Encryption: Data at rest is AES-256; backups are encrypted and stored in AWS us-east-1. Subprocessors include: AWS (infrastructure), Snowflake (analytics), Sentry (monitoring). See attachment for details.

Attached: Subprocessors_List_v2.xlsx (stub), ClearWave_SOC2_Summary.pdf (stub)

W-9 and billing contact are with our finance team — I'll get them to you by EOD tomorrow. We can take the 10:30 PT call — sending calendar invite now.

Thanks,
Sophie

Thanks Sophie — got the spreadsheet and SOC summary. A few follow-ups before I hand to Legal/Finance for PO routing: 

- Please confirm the DocuSign link you prefer for the DPA (your template) or confirm you'll sign the Redwood template we sent. We have a 5 business day review SLAT for vendor DPA redlines; if the vendor-proposed redlines are material, Legal will request a short review period.
- Confirm billing contact + W-9 ETA. Finance needs remit details to create the PO.
- Karthik — can you confirm whether procurement can issue a provisional PO (non-production) while DPA is finalizing? If not, we'll await Legal signoff.

Marissa — adding you for quick legal sanity check on retention language above (13 months default) and whether the 7-year backups for audit customers needs an exception.

If everyone agrees, I'll draft a mutual action plan and timeline and share via HubSpot linked to the deal record.

Best,
